decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-19 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Insurance Institute was established in 1982 to act as the central organization for the promotion and development of education in the insurance sector and is the only professional institution in Sri Lanka that conducts educational programmes, training sessions and professional examinations in insurance. Passing the examinations conducted by the Sri Lanka Insurance Institute on behalf of the Insurance Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka is essential to qualify as a licensed insurance agent under the Regulation of Insurance Industry Act, No.43 of 2000. The then Ministry in charge of the subject of Finance has drafted a preliminary Bill in the years 2018 and 2019 to incorporate the Sri Lanka Insurance Institute in order to provide the said Institute with the necessary powers to carry out its functions in a proper manner and to enable it to operate as a financially sustainable institution. The concurrence of the present Insurance Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka has been received for the said preliminary Bill. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare the Sri Lanka Insurance Institute Bill, based on the said preliminary Bill, was approved by the Cabinet.
